assumptions.mass_status: estimates; physical part weights, print settings and internal distributions are not measured
assumptions.zp10d_mass_distribution: 56 g per current servo assembly, split over body and horns by current BRep volume; S01/S06 single-output actual mass remains unmeasured
assumptions.printed_parts: original robot-pickle mass divided by original BRep volume, applied to current BRep volume
assumptions.other_components: original component mass retained, current BRep used for centre and inertia with uniform effective density
assumptions.legacy_zero_mass_parts: flash reflector/light module assigned provisional 1250 kg/m3 instead of zero mass
assumptions.sg90_actuation: provisional kp=0.3, kv=0.002, +/-0.1 Nm; +/-90 degrees is a diagnostic range, not an established physical operating range
assumptions.zp10d_response: inherited kp=13.37, damping=0.56, frictionloss=0.068, armature=0.027; unmeasured
assumptions.zp10d_torque: published stall torque +/-0.980665 Nm; not continuous rated torque
assumptions.collision: printed shells/brackets use convex decomposition, with per-part target parameters recorded above; hull caps may exceed those targets. Servo housings/horns and purchased components use conservative hulls that fill holes. Original STEP self-intersection warnings remain; not a 0.2 mm clearance proof. Same-body and immediate parent-child contacts are excluded by MuJoCo.
assumptions.structural_strength: rigid-body model only; no FEA or printed-part strength certification

gravity_loads.scope: Gravity only, base hypothetically supported; not standing inverse dynamics, dynamic loading or continuous torque rating.

validation.contact_scope: Convex proxies on all physical parts. MuJoCo excludes same-body and immediate parent-child pairs by default; this is not exhaustive CAD clearance validation.
